blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Inquirer Interactive Inc. Chief Content Officer (CCO) Arlene Burgos is the lone southeast Asian in this year’s premier visitor exchange program of the United States. Filipino journalist Burgos, nominated by the US Embassy in Manila to the International Visitors Leadership Program (IVLP) for 2026, joins 24 other nationalities from around the world in an almost month-long swing across the US for networking and exposure. Burgos is slated to take part in the multi-regional project titled ‘AI Innovation and Security’ professional exchange program that will run almost entire October.
